comments.body: Non-string scalar-list defaults silently disappear in traditional configuration. For example, `defaults.get("acme").setDefault("retry_delays", Arrays.asList(100L, 500L))` exports `100,500`, but reading it through the flat bridge with `getScalarList("retry_delays", Long.class)` returns null, whereas applying the same defaults to the declarative model returns `[100, 500]`. `ConfigPropertiesBackedDeclarativeConfigProperties.getScalarList` only supports `String.class`, so accepting boolean/numeric elements here cannot preserve the default across modes. Either support those typed reads in the bridge or reject these lists from `toConfigProperties()`, as is already done for empty lists. Please cover a non-string list in the cross-mode tests.

Joining string elements without checking for commas silently changes supported defaults. For example, setting `general.sanitization.url.sensitive_query_parameters` to the single-element list `["api,key"]` through `customizeGeneral` preserves that literal parameter name in declarative mode, but this export produces `api,key`, which the flat bridge reads as two names, `api` and `key`. The configured `api,key` parameter therefore is not redacted in flat mode. Reject elements that cannot round-trip through the traditional list format, or use a lossless encoding supported by the reader, rather than accepting and changing their meaning.
